title: SLOT-V: Supervised Learning of Observer Models for Legible Robot Motion Planning in Manipulation
findings: Not applicable. The paper's findings are entirely within the domain of robotics and machine learning, focusing on the proposed SLOT-V framework's ability to learn observer models, generalize to new environments, and its sample efficiency compared to an inverse reinforcement learning approach. There are no findings related to religion.
